dslRule:
<!id: anonymous.comparator.collections.sort.to.lambda>
<!description: Replaces an anonymous Comparator implementation passed to Collections.sort with a lambda expression.
This applies when the anonymous class only overrides the 'compare' method and has no other members.>
<!severity: HINT>
java.util.Collections.sort($list, new java.util.Comparator<$TypeParam>() { @java.lang.Override public int compare($param1, $param2) { $bodyStatements$ } })
:: sourceVersionGE(8)
=> java.util.Collections.sort($list, ($param1, $param2) -> { $bodyStatements$ })
;;
summary: Convert an anonymous class implementing `Comparator` passed to `Collections.sort` to a lambda expression.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
